MATCH (t:Type)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(i:Type)
WHERE i.name = 'NotificationChannel'
MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(t)
RETURN t.fqn AS fqn, t.name AS name, t.kind AS kind,
  split(a.fileName, '/target/')[0] + '/src/main/java/' + replace(t.fqn, '.', '/') + '.java' AS file,
  i.fqn AS implements_interface
ORDER BY t.fqn
